entry.name: Machine Learning Specialization
entry.note: Andrew Ng's rebuilt classic; the most common starting point in the field

covers: supervised learning with linear and logistic regression
Python with NumPy, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow
reading.format: Three-course online program with video lectures, optional math videos, ungraded notebooks, practice quizzes, and graded assignments.
reading.summary: The Machine Learning Specialization is a three-course online program created by DeepLearning.AI and Stanford Online and taught by Andrew Ng. It teaches machine learning fundamentals, from supervised learning to neural networks, decision trees, unsupervised learning, recommender systems, and reinforcement learning. Finishing the program shows the ability to build effective learning algorithms and apply them to real applications.
reading.audience: It is for beginners breaking into AI. No prior math knowledge or rigorous coding background is required.
reading.prerequisites: No prior math knowledge or rigorous coding background required; math videos are optional.
